signals.title: Scaloni Confirms Messi Out for Argentina vs Burkina Faso
signals.content: Argentina will face Burkina Faso on Saturday without Lionel Messi.

signals.title: Verstappen Takes Pole at Sepang to Replace Bahrain GP
signals.content: Max Verstappen secured pole position for the Formula One race held in Malaysia's Sepang circuit.

signals.title: Govt to spend €19bn preparing Budapest-Budapest-High-Speed Rail
signals.content: The Hungarian government plans preparations for a high-speed rail line connecting Budapest with Vienna and Warsaw.

signals.title: Milos Kerkez Scores Hat-Trick Goal Against Georgia
signals.content: Hungary defeated Georgia 1-0 at Puskas Arena.

signals.title: Cable Fire Halts Rail Service on Key Hungary-Austria Line
signals.content: A cable fire caused disruption to rail traffic between Hegyeshalom and Vienna; replacement buses were organized.

signals.title: Spiny Tribulus Causes Bike Tyres to Burst Across Hungary
signals.content: The prickly tribulus plant caused bicycle tire punctures across multiple cities.
